brief.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: One finished Japanese basketball news article thumbnail, landscape 16:9, requested 1920 × 1080 PNG.
Create a polished bold editorial sports thumbnail for バスケまとめ. Use near-black #151A18 background, electric lime #CCF43B, ivory text, and one orange basketball. Hand-drawn ink and dry-brush texture, assertive thick Japanese gothic typography, sparse composition, high contrast and clean legibility. The approved visual language has large white Japanese headlines, lime brush accents and expressive black ink illustration.
Composition: left roughly 70% holds clearly ordered text with generous safe margins. Right roughly 30% holds one large hand-drawn orange basketball and minimal abstract court-line arcs, framed by a restrained diagonal lime brush stroke. No people, no faces, no hands, no team marks or sponsor logos. Ball illustration is symbolic, not an actual game scene. Keep texture away from small lettering.
Text, exactly as follows, in this visual reading order:
Top small masthead: "バスケまとめ"
Large headline: "10/30 試合結果"
Small tag above the score: "B.ONE｜終了"
Main score in very large bold text, keeping teams and scores clearly paired: "愛媛 76–78 香川"
Two clearly readable qualifier lines below the score: "ほかの試合・当日EFFは" and "公式記録確定待ち"
Small as-of line: "2026/10/30 21:42 JST時点"
At the bottom, two readable disclosure phrases: "イラスト（AI生成）" and "成績をもとにしたイメージ"
Use lime prominently for the score or brush highlight; ivory for main headline; the pending-record qualifier must remain visually prominent and not be hidden as fine print.
Accuracy: only the Ehime 76 versus Kagawa 78 score is reported finished. Other games' official records and all daily EFF rankings are still pending in the fixed source. Do not imply that all games or rankings are finalized. Do not add players, rankings, EFF numbers, fictional game moments, victory claims, old dates, other teams, or any additional text. Carefully render every Japanese character, team name, date, and digit. Keep all text safely within the canvas with no clipping. Produce exactly one complete image.
